title: Warmly Spiced Moroccan Black Beans Tagine
description: A hearty Moroccan dish featuring fermented black beans, perfect for a hangover cure, made with ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients and grilled to perfection on a yakimono-grill.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the ground cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked fermented black beans and stir to combine with the spice mixture.
Cover the tagine or Dutch oven and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
Grill the tagine in a yakimono-grill for an additional 5 minutes, if desired, to add a smoky flavor.
